description:
Rotaract Club of Wilson College, Girgaon, Mumbai*

*Installation Ceremony Successfully Conducted*

The Installation Ceremony of the newly appointed President Rotaractor Vardha Chavan and the Board of Directors of the Rotaract Club of Wilson College, Girgaon, Mumbai was conducted with great enthusiasm and positive energy.

Rtn. Ramu Gadkar, President of Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sealand, attended the ceremony and extended his warm congratulations and best wishes to President Rotaractor Vardha Chavan and the entire new team.
During his address,

Rtn. Ramu Gadkar shared valuable guidance on leadership, teamwork, social responsibility and youth empowerment. He encouraged the Rotaractors to take up meaningful community service projects and become responsible leaders who create positive change in society.
